Name: Bog's Monster Sanctuary
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/4xDMFWtM/retro-bookcase-(2).png[/img]
[b][size=4]IT'S HERE! IT'S FINALLY HERE![/size]

[/b]Hello you wonderful [b]goblins, witches, forest folk and ghouls![/b] Bog’s Monster Sanctuary, the companion mod to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38014]Bog’s Monster Mash[/url], has been a labor of love for both Abagaianye and me.

Deep underground the monsters have been meeting. They have been conversing…. maybe… just possibly… you may be one of the people they have been hoping for. A chance for… friendship or sanctuary?

Monster Sanctuary takes the 53 monster variants from Monster Mash and now they drop their souls! In combination with some magic Summoning Circles and some Void Essence you will be able to open a portal into your very own Monster Sanctuary Building where they can live and of course bring you presents of their drops!

Not to mention… [b]NEW CHARMER RINGS GALORE![/b]

Do you want a whole Monster Sanctuary filled with [b]Furniture Mimics[/b] so you can decorate your farmhouse with the furniture they bring you? You got it.

Never go to the mines again with a [b]Monster Sanctuary[/b] filled with [b]Ore Gargoyles[/b]? Totally possible!

Decorate a dream monster garden with [b]Mossy Oculus[/b], [b]Garden[/b] and [b]Mushroom Goblins[/b]? Never again need to craft tea saplings and garden pots! Plus the[b] Mossy Oculus[/b] has got you covered on moss and mossy seeds.

Collect every single monster variant, including the [b]Super Rares[/b], or min max for the best most efficient run. We built this mod for flexibility and added fun for every type of playthrough. 

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/HxHNTj6S/retro-bookcase-3.png[/img]

[u][size=2][b]Monster Souls[/b][/size][/u]
[list]
[*][size=2]1% drop chance from all Monster Variants in the mines - Monster Compendium does increase this! Currently Burglar Ring does not. [/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Super Rares have a 100% chance to drop their Soul.[/size][/*]
[*]If you already have super rare souls from Monster Mash version 1.0.2 or earlier when you install Monster Sanctuary, those souls will change name, description, and icon to match the Monster Sanctuary souls. They will also still work for summoning monsters. However, they will be listed with a different sell price (500g instead of 150g) and won't stack with the new souls you obtain. This shouldn't affect gameplay but if you want them to stack we recommend trashing the older souls and using a mod like CJB Item Spawner to spawn replacements.[/*]
[/list][spoiler][size=2]Monsters do not breed like slimes, but they will drop additional souls for you to collect inside the Monster Sanctuary to summon more![/size][/spoiler]

[size=2]
[u]
Exceptions[/u][/size]
[list]
[*][size=2]Although Starfruit Duggies drop a soul, they cannot be summoned because they yearn for the wide open spaces (comparatively) of the mines - the other Duggy variants do not drop souls at all.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Grubs cannot be summoned and do not drop souls.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Slimes can be raised in Monster Sanctuaries but they are done so using vanilla methods and do not drop souls.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Big Slimes cannot be summoned and do not drop souls.[/size][/*]
[/list]

[b][u]Monster Sanctuary Building[/u][/b]
Hint: befriend Krobus
NOTE: upgrading the sanctuary requires enabling the [b]Monster Hutch Expansion[/b] config setting in the [b]Monster Hutch Framework[/b] config options (NOT Monster Sanctuary's config!)
[spoiler]Reach 4 hearts with Krobus and have seen the new sewer event to unlock the building at Robin’s.

[b][u]Building Details:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Build for 5,000g 200 stone and 25 hardwood - 7x4 tilesize.[/*]
[*]Upgrade for 15,000g 500 stone and 5 iridium bars - 11x4 tilesize.[/*]
[*]Upgraded Monster Sanctuary allows cask placement and becomes larger! Requires enabling the [b]Monster Hutch Expansion[/b] config setting in the [b]Monster Hutch Framework[/b] config options.[/*]
[*]Allows for tree placement with[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943] Let's Move It[/url].[/*]
[*]Sprinklers can be placed ANYWHERE for the trough watering.[/*]
[*]AUTO GRABBER WORKS.[/*]
[*]Auto Petter is not needed as the monsters do not NEED to be pet, but you can pet them (while wearing a Charmer Ring) if you would like!﻿[/*]
[*]You can have Monster Sanctuaries and Slime Hutches; slimes can be raised in either, but monsters cannot be raised in Slime Hutches.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[b][u]Summoning Circle Machine[/u][/b]
Hint: befriend Krobus
[spoiler]unlocked in the same new event as the Monster Sanctuary 

Crafting Recipe: 2 iridium bars & 50 void essence

[u]Machine Details:
[/u]Default Summoning Time:
[list]
[*]Common summoning time: 3 days[/*]
[*]Uncommon summoning time: 4 days[/*]
[*]Super Rare summoning time: 5 days[/*]
[/list]The summoning time is completely configurable to your playstyle in the Mod Options![/spoiler]
[b][u]
Monster Charmer Rings[/u][/b]
Hint: level up skills in the mines and visit Krobus
NOTE: [b]projectile damage[/b] from monsters WILL STILL DAMAGE AND HIT YOU. This is currently a limitation of the game - we will continue to try to find solutions but it may always stay a limitation.

[spoiler]As you level up in mining skill you will unlock Charmer rings recipes that you will be able to purchase for 5,000g each at Krobus’ shop. The Monster Charmer Ring recipe will be sent to you in the mail after you have crafted all the other rings.

Monster Charmer Ring has two config options for the recipe:
[list]
[*]Default recipe: 1 prismatic shard, 10 iridium bars, 50 hardwood, 1 monster musk[/*]
[*]Optional recipe: 1 of every single Super Rare Monster Soul. Stardrop Oculus Soul, Golden Mimic Soul, Golden Pumpkin Soul, Treasure Artifact Turtle Soul, Magma Spore Sprite Soul, Shadow Enchantress Soul, Mushroom Goblin Soul, Prismatic Gargoyle Soul, & 1 Prismatic Shard[/*]
[/list]
All Charmer Rings:
[list]
[*]Duggy Charmer Ring - Mining lv.2, received via mail[/*]
[*]Fly Charmer Ring - Mining lv.2, received via mail[/*]
[*]Geode Turtle Charmer Ring - Mining lv.2, received via mail[/*]
[*]Bat Charmer Ring - Mining lv. 4, in Krobus' Shop[/*]
[*]Ore Gargoyle Charmer Ring - Mining lv. 4, in Krobus' Shop[/*]
[*]Spore Spirit Charmer Ring - Mining lv. 6, in Krobus' Shop[/*]
[*]Ghost Charmer Ring - Mining lv. 6, in Krobus' Shop[/*]
[*]Skeleton Charmer Ring - Mining lv. 6, in Krobus' Shop[/*]
[*]Mimic Charmer Ring - Mining lv. 8, in Krobus' Shop[/*]
[*]Oculus Charmer Ring - Mining lv. 8, in Krobus' Shop[/*]
[*]Goblin Charmer Ring - Mining lv. 9, in Krobus' Shop[/*]
[*]Shadow Charmer Ring - Mining lv. 9, in Krobus' Shop[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/0NJ69yzS/retro-bookcase-5.png[/img]
[b][u][size=5]CONFIG[/size][/u][/b]
[b][u]Summoning (incubation) Time[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Customise the summoning time for common, uncommon, and super rare monsters.[/*]
[*]Choose between 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, or 15 days.[/*]
[*]Defaults: Common = 3 days; Uncommon = 4 days; Super Rare = 5 days.[/*]
[/list][b][u]
Monster Charmer Ring Recipe[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Choose between the default or harder-to-find ingredients.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Soul Perfection Exclusion[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Monster souls are excluded from perfection requirements by default but can be enabled to require shipping one of each for perfection.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Alt Super Rare Soul Textures[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Choose between a soul texture that matches the other souls (default) or use the original textures from Monster Mash (which look more like the monster sprites).[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Produce Is Dropped[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]By default, produce that monsters give overnight will be dropped like wood from a tree (where it is automatically picked up when you go near it). Disable to make it behave like forage where it stays stuck to the floor and has to be picked up manually.[/*]
[*]Bombs, Monster Musk, tree seeds, and furniture are excluded from this config because they must always be dropped in order to be obtainable at all.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Little Ghost Glow[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Summoned Little Ghosts do not glow by default; the glow can be enabled with this config setting with the side effect that they will randomly change colour every time you load a save.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Monster Hutch Framework Settings[/u][/b]
[list]
Some settings must be configured in the Monster Hutch Framework config page instead of the Monster Sanctuary one. See IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR MONSTER HUTCH FRAMEWORK SETTINGS below for details.[/list]

[u][b][size=5]ACCESSIBILITY[/size][/b][/u]
[b][u]Vision
[/u][/b]  ﻿[u][i]Stardew Access[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod is mostly compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16205]Stardew Access[/url]﻿. All mechanics and content are available, but there are a few quirks.[/*]
[*]Stardew Access does not differentiate between monster variants, so all the variants for a given monster type will be described by the vanilla name. E.g., Shadow Witch, Shadow Wizard, and Shadow Enchantress variants will all be called “Shadow Shaman” by Stardew Access. Their souls will be correctly differentiated, however, so it is possible to control which variants you raise by being selective about the souls you summon.[/*]
[*]Stardew Access cannot currently identify the door of the Monster Sanctuary building. If Grid Movement is enabled, the player will warp into the building when walking onto the tile south of the door.[/*]
[*]When entering the building, Stardew Access will read out the ID of the sanctuary instead of its display name.[/*]
[/list]  ﻿
[u]  ﻿[i]Trypophobia[/i][/u]
[list]
[*]Trypophobia warning: this mod has a monster based on a Morel mushroom. We do not have a trypophobia mode at present but intend to add one in our next update.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Sound[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Play with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39416]No Fly Sound[/url] mod to remove the buzzing sound from Cave Flies.[/*]
[/list]
We welcome requests for any additional accessibility changes our players may need.

[u][b][size=5]COMPATIBILITY[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]This mod REQUIRES Monster Mash (minimum version 1.1.0) - it cannot work without it and we will not take requests to make it do so.[/*]
[*]Monster retexture mods will not affect your sanctuary monsters even if you disable a variant in Monster Mash - if you want your sanctuary monsters to have a different texture you will need to edit or make a mod that targets the MS textures directly.[/*]
[*]Mostly compatible with juminos's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31903]Monster Hutch Starter Pack[/url] mod - the monsters and rings from both mods work as intended (although there are some rings that are named the same in both mods) but there are no separate monster hutches and incubators, so Monster Sanctuary's must be used for MHSP.[/*]
[*]Mostly compatible with other content packs for Monster Hutch Framework (when they exist) - as with MHSP, the rings and monsters from both mods will work as intended but they will share a hutch building and incubator machine.[/*]
[*]SVE: As SVE changes how the sewer is unlocked, it may make the progression of this mod a different experience to vanilla. Whether it makes it faster or slower will depend on whether you find SVE's sewer unlock method easier or harder than vanilla's.[/*]
[*]Building retextures: mostly compatible with AT - building textures will look strange in the paint bucket menu but will apply properly on the building itself (this is due to AT not being able to handle SeasonOffset properly and not a bug on our side); fully compatible with skins added using CP.[/*]
[/list]

[u][b][size=5]UNINSTALLATION[/size][/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Kill all the monsters in any Monster Sanctuary buildings you own.[/*]
[*]Visit Robin to demolish all Monster Sanctuary buildings - important! You may experience an error that crashes your game when saving if you do not do this before uninstalling.[/*]
[*]Sell/delete all monster souls, summoning circles, and charmer rings.[/*]
[*]Uninstall Monster Sanctuary.[/*]
[*]Uninstall Monster Hutch Framework (if not using another content pack for it).[/*]
[/list][img]https://i.postimg.cc/QML86j0h/retro-bookcase-(2).png[/img]

[size=5][b][u]KNOWN ISSUES / IMPORTANT NOTES[/u][/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Sometimes monsters will get "stuck" and not move. I HIGHLY recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20943]Let's Move it[/url]﻿ as you can move entities like monsters and animals with the mod as well. [/*]
[*]Little Ghost glowing issue. There is a config option that you can toggle which will allow the Little Ghosts to glow on your farm and inside the Monster Sanctuary, the only issue is it will randomize the color of the Little Ghost every time you load a save. [/*]
[/list]
[b][u][size=5]IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR MONSTER HUTCH FRAMEWORK SETTINGS[/size]
[/u][/b]
Some settings relevant to Monster Sanctuary are present in the config for Monster Hutch Framework instead. (Note: this is not a list of all the settings, just the ones most relevant to Monster Sanctuary.)

[b][u]Monster Hutch Expansion[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Must be enabled to be able to upgrade your Monster Sanctuary at Robin's.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Randomize Monster Positions[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]With this setting disabled, monsters stay in the same spot overnight as they were in when the player last left the sanctuary.[/*]
[*]Enabling it randomizes each monster’s position in the sanctuary, making it look more natural.[/*]
[*]However, if players are using fencing to control where the monsters can go in the sanctuary, this setting can put monsters outside the fencing.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Monster Capacity[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Control how many monsters will fit in your Sanctuary. The number is the same for the regular and upgraded Sanctuary.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Additional Required Item ID - the “fuel” needed to be added to Summoning Circles along with souls[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Monster Sanctuary overrides this value with one that we have chosen. Changing this will not do anything.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Additional Required Item Count - how many of the additional item are needed[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Monster Sanctuary overrides this value with one that we have chosen. Changing this will not do anything.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Crafting Recipe - the crafting recipe for the Summoning Circle[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Default: 2x iridium bars, 50x void essence.[/*]
[*]Players can change this to whatever they want.[/*]
[*]Requires a game restart for changes to take effect.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Recipe Unlock - how to unlock the crafting recipe for the Summoning Circle[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Monster Sanctuary overrides this value with one that we have chosen. Changing this will not do anything.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Lethal Rings (default disabled)[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]When disabled, the charm rings prevent the player from damaging monsters in addition to stopping monsters from damaging them.[/*]
[*]Enable to allow the player to damage monsters.[/*]
[/list]
[b][u]Vanilla Slime Ring (default disabled)[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]When disabled, stops players from being able to damage slimes when wearing the vanilla slime ring.[/*]
[*]Enable to allow the player to damage slimes.[/*]
[/list]
